title: extensions/actions/0.1: every action a person can take on a service, and the agent tool that takes it (fabric-actions/0.1, DEC-0121)
description: The value of the actions extension key https://fabric.passioncode.ai/agent-contract/extensions/actions/0.1 in a service's well-known document (AP-1): each action its dashboard, app or page lets a person take, the tool on its agent surface that performs it with the same effect, checks, audit record and an idempotency key, and who decides it. A checker reports an invalid value, a repeated id, a humanStep that disagrees with gate and a tool missing from a present surfaces.mcp.capabilities as FAC-SEM-142. docs/specification/service.md#actions.

levels.description: DEC-0162 LV-5: the organizations whose levels this service reads, each with the audience that organization's issuer registered it by as an org-membership/2 reader; the hub fetches a level holder's attestation for that audience and binds it by mem. Absent: the service reads no levels (LV-10).

id.description: The action's id, once in the list (FAC-SEM-142): letters, digits, _ . - up to 64, the shape of an input request's key, which is a job's input action's id (DEC-0121).

title.description: What the button says to a person.

tool.description: The capability on the service's agent surface that performs the action; when surfaces.mcp.capabilities is present it lists this name (FAC-SEM-142).

gate.description: none: the caller's own act. relayed: the operator decides, and a T0 or T1 caller carries the decision in _meta.decision (AP-2). human: a step only the person takes (AP-4), named by humanStep.

humanStep.description: Present exactly when gate is human (FAC-SEM-142): the step the tool hands the person with human-step-required.

level.description: DEC-0162 LV-7: the lowest level that decides this relayed action in an organization, owner for a billing act (the organization's plan, its payment method, its invoices, setting or changing L0, a project's L1 or a key's ceiling), operator for an act no level decides (issuing, rotating or revoking a client key, DEC-0159 CF-3); absent: an architect in the call's project, admin for a call in no project. Only on a relayed action (FAC-SEM-142).
